epics.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Cycle Findings
epics.jtbd: When a self-falsification audit identifies unresolved findings, I want the root causes to be fixed directly, so that the container starts and the CI pipeline passes without inventing adjacent scope.
requirements: R1: Add at least one test for each modified function in AuthController.
R2: Generate refresh tokens using real cryptographic work instead of returning a hardcoded predictable fixture.
R3: Correct the coverage audit report to accurately reflect gaps and CI test failures instead of falsely claiming zero gaps.
R4: Wire the parsed OIDC token claims for department and courses into the User persistence layer.
R5: Fix the authorization mechanism to properly address the 401 Unauthorized root cause, modifying access control logic appropriately.
R6: Implement tests that provide a failing counterexample or a targeted passing test that would fail under the defect, fulfilling falsifiability requirements.

slices.title: Patch authentication defects and audit reporting findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want to resolve the token generation, OIDC claims persistence, audit reporting, and authorization defects directly in the existing code, so that the self-falsification audit passes.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the AuthController generates a refresh token, When it is invoked, Then it must perform real cryptographic generation rather than returning a predictable fixture.
Given an OIDC token with department and courses claims, When it is parsed into MoodleProfile, Then the claims must be wired into the User persistence layer.
Given a coverage audit report generation, When the core requirements are unfulfilled or CI tests fail, Then the report must accurately output the identified gaps.

slices.title: Verify falsification fixes and test coverage completeness
slices.jtbd: When implementing the test coverage for this epic, I want to verify that the AuthController and access control mechanisms are fully tested with counterexamples, so that the self-falsification audit passes.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the modified functions in AuthController, When tests are executed, Then at least one test must be present for each modified function.
Given the defect conditions in the authorization mechanism, When the targeted test is run, Then it must act as a failing counterexample or a passing test that would fail under the defect.
Given the overall falsification fixes, When the integration tests run, Then all authorization paths must be verified and 401 defects confirmed fixed.
